hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */_site/*|_site/*|*/_zip/*|_zip/*|*/deno.lock|deno.lock) echo "Blocked: $f is generated output (_site/, _zip/, deno.lock). Edit the sources instead; deno.lock is managed by Deno itself." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */node_modules/*|*/_site/*) ;; *.ts|*.tsx) deno fmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; *.css) deno fmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; deno run -A npm:stylelint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
